shared_elements: incised linear geometric patterning (bands, parallel lines)
justification: Both surfaces carry schematic incised human forms and simple circular/disc motifs combined with linear geometric banding, which is about as generic as shared iconography gets. A depicts a single monumental anthropomorph whose body carries a symmetrical arrangement of a chest disc, chevrons and horizontal bands, whereas B is a crowded narrative panel of manned boats, quadrupeds, a raised-arm figure and a large ladder-like grid, with no counterpart to A's body-centred symbolic layout.
